{{Top|leg}}
The '''Authority Ship Registry''' was a comprehensive database of all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], maintained by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The Registry detailed all Authority vessels and independent ships; entry onto the registry could only be obtained after passing the strict requirements of the [[Authority Starship Code Safety Registry]].
